message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious naming variants and duplicate entries were consolidated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-11 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-12 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-12 05:10 IST through 2026-10-13 05:10 IST**).

One newly reported, plausibly relevant security development was verified in the last 24 hours.

### SonicWall SMA 8200V — CVE-2026-102255

- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 10.0 (SonicWall)
- **What changed:** SecurityWeek reported on October 12 that third-party sensors observed exploitation attempts against this pre-authentication server-side request forgery vulnerability. SonicWall's product notice, last updated October 6, still states that the vendor had no evidence of exploitation at that time.
- **Description:** A remote, unauthenticated attacker may cause the SMA 1000 Work Place interface to issue requests on the attacker's behalf, reach internal functionality, and perform unauthorized operations.
- **Why it is relevant:** The monitored inventory explicitly lists **SonicWall SMA 8200V 12.4.1-02965**. SonicWall identifies the 8200v as affected and lists 12.4.3-03526 and earlier as vulnerable, so the inventoried 12.4.1 build falls within the affected range.
- **Sources:** [SonicWall product notice SNWLID-2026-0017](https://www.sonicwall.com/support/notices/kA1VN000002QP3G0AW); [SecurityWeek exploitation report, October 12, 2026](https://www.securityweek.com/critical-sonicwall-vulnerability-exploited-days-after-disclosure/)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations.

No MongoDB-family vulnerability could be verified as newly reported or authoritatively updated within this scan window. PyMongo advisories found during the sweep were published or last updated on October 5 or earlier and were excluded as stale.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for any internet-accessible SMA 8200V still running the inventoried 12.4.1 build because the issue is critical, unauthenticated, and now subject to reported exploitation attempts. Validate the installed platform hotfix against SonicWall's fixed-version guidance. No other credible, newly reported finding survived the freshness, product-match, and deduplication checks.
